name: Technological and Higher Education Institute of Hong Kong
summary: Chai Wan and Tsing Yi applied institute with four-year degrees in design, engineering, hospitality, sport and food science, mostly taught in English.

handoff.label: Programmes and fees for international students

ib.text: Non-local qualifications are assessed individually by each department; no IB points are published. English: IB English B grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL, or English A grade 4. Design programmes need a portfolio.

faculties.name: Department of Construction, Environment and Engineering
faculties.line: Civil, building services and aircraft engineering and surveying degrees, taught in English.

faculties.name: Department of Design and Architecture
faculties.line: Fashion, product design and landscape architecture, taught in English; applicants submit a work portfolio.

faculties.name: Department of Digital Innovation and Technology
faculties.line: Multimedia, ICT, cyber security, cinematic arts and AI degrees; Multimedia Technology and Innovation needs a portfolio.

faculties.name: Department of Food and Health Sciences
faculties.line: Chinese medicinal pharmacy, nutrition and healthcare management and horticulture degrees; one is taught in Cantonese.

faculties.name: Department of Hospitality and Business Management
faculties.line: Hotel operations, culinary arts and management, and public relations and events management degrees.

faculties.name: Department of Sport and Recreation
faculties.line: Sports and recreation management, sports coaching and sports therapy degrees.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: THEi's non-local tuition for 2026/27 ranged from HK$117,000 to HK$187,020 a year by programme, and 2027/28 is not published yet.
Applications for 2027 entry are not dated yet; they are processed first come, first served, so apply early. You may name at most two degrees among six choices.
The published catalogue is for 2026/27 and includes Putonghua- or Cantonese-taught exceptions. Confirm the 2027/28 course and teaching language before applying.
